simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֶּצֶל (H1211) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בֶּצֶל (betsel) means an onion First listed occurrence: Num 11 5.

definitions.full: H1211. batsal [ בָּצָל ] noun masculine onion (Late Hebrew בָּצֵל or בֶּ֫צֶל , Arabic , Ethiopic Aramaic בּוּצְלָא , ) — בְּצָלִים Num 11:5 ( ׳וְאֶתהַֿבּ וְאֵתהַֿשּׁוּמִים וְאֶתהֶֿחָצִיר הָאֲבַטִּתִים וְאֵת הַקִּשֻּׁאִים אֵת ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;
